defects.defect: The large empty brown gap makes the bottom of the screen feel disconnected and unfinished.
defects.direction: Reduce the gap or use it for framed progression detail so the Play button and nav bar feel deliberately grouped.
defects.region: lower half, between Play button and nav bar

defects.defect: Left and right decorative icon columns (rocks, skull, campfire / tent, grass, cactus) sit on empty wood with no framed slots or path context, and the wide dark wood areas between them and the center path read as unfinished filler
defects.direction: Give the side icons framed nodes or scenery grouping, or narrow the panel so the map path fills it; avoid large flat empty wood areas
defects.region: level map panel, side icons columns (x≈60-200 and x≈530-670, y≈800-1100)

defects.defect: Level path is a single vertical rail with two locked nodes above node 1; it is centered horizontally but visually top-heavy/empty relative to the panel width, and the rail is clipped at the panel's top edge rather than resolving into a frame
defects.direction: Let the path meander and terminate cleanly inside the frame with padding at the top, matching Kingdom Rush-style winding maps

defects.defect: The energy-cost chip is crowded against the Play label and competes with the primary call to action.
defects.direction: Increase separation before the chip and slightly reduce its visual weight.

defects.defect: The title-to-scene gap is tighter than several neighboring section gaps, weakening the otherwise measured vertical rhythm.
defects.direction: Add a little breathing room below the title or normalize adjacent section spacing.

defects.defect: gap below the Play button (~90px of bare striped background) is noticeably larger than the consistent margins used between the other stacked sections
defects.direction: tighten the Play-button-to-nav-bar margin toward the ~30px rhythm used elsewhere, or vertically distribute the sections so gaps read equal
defects.region: band between Play button and bottom nav bar

defects.defect: Gap between the top bar and the title (≈35px) is much smaller than the gap between the Play button and the nav bar (≈90px); vertical rhythm between the framed sections is uneven
defects.direction: Equalize the vertical gaps between top bar → title → scene → map → Play → nav bar

defects.defect: Name pills sit on the bottom edge of the scene panel, with 'Bastion' and 'Sage' nearly touching the panel's rounded border; unequal side margins compared to the centered 'Ember' pill
defects.direction: Inset the outer name pills so all three share equal padding from the scene panel edges

defects.defect: nav icons vary slightly in visual weight (gear reads smaller/thinner than the rift portal and hat)
defects.direction: normalize the four nav icons to a common bounding size so their optical weight matches

defects.defect: The four resource pills are unequal widths (energy pill widest, gem pill narrower) so the row lacks the uniform cadence of the nav bar below
defects.direction: Normalize resource chip widths or distribute them with equal flex so the row reads as a consistent set

defects.defect: The map panel is visually much taller and heavier than the hero scene, pulling focus away from the title and character selection.
defects.direction: Slightly shorten the map panel or increase the visual prominence of the scene/title group.

defects.defect: columns immediately flanking the lock/medallion path are empty dark wood, so the panel's inner area reads slightly sparse compared to the decorated outer columns
defects.direction: add small prop/decoration sprites or path connectors in the inner columns so the map panel reads fully dressed
defects.region: level map panel, middle columns beside the center path

defects.defect: Title is the only unframed element and its purple glow/sparkle asymmetry makes the lettering read slightly right of the panel axis; the 'Mage Master' word block extends closer to the right edge than the left
defects.direction: Center the lettering block optically on the same axis as the panels and balance the glow/sparkles on both sides

defects.defect: Flat brown background with faint diagonal stripes reads as placeholder between the framed panels
defects.direction: Add subtle parchment/wood texture or vignette so the gaps feel intentionally designed
defects.region: page background behind title and Play button

defects.defect: gap below the Play button (~90px of bare striped background) is noticeably larger than the consistent margins used between the other stacked sections
